An anchor split around a block drops its empty half when the reconstructed half carries the text

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<a href=\"/o\"><div>Text<a href=\"/i\">Inner</a></div></a>");
var_dump($result->content);
```
